- Returns 200: array of taskinfo

### GET /das/v1/identity-collectors

`listIdentityCollectorsV1` — List identity collectors

This endpoint lists the identity collectors in Data Access Security with optional filtering and pagination. Sorting is not supported for this endpoint; supplying the `sorters` query parameter results in a validation error.

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage, das:identity-collectors:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: sourceId: eq; type: eq, in; id: eq, in; name: eq, co — e.g. `name co "Finance" and type eq "AWS"`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of identitycollectorlistitem

### POST /das/v1/identity-collectors

`createIdentityCollectorV1` — Create identity collector

This endpoint creates a new identity collector in Data Access Security for the specified source. The identity collector type is derived from the source. Optionally configure `users` and `groups` to register source attributes (`properties`) and map them to data dictionary fields by name (`fieldMappings.fieldDictionaryName`). When omitted, both collections are created with fixed columns only.

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createidentitycollectorrequest
- Returns 201: object

### GET /das/v1/identity-collectors/types

`getIdentityCollectorTypesV1` — List identity collector types

Returns the public identity collector types exposed for metadata and UI discovery, including the SailPoint Identity Security `connectorName` values to use when listing sources for each type. This endpoint lists base types only (for example, `Box` rather than `Box SaaS`). SaaS variants are not listed as separate types; create derives the identity collector type from `sourceId`. Existing identity collectors may still report SaaS variant types in list and update responses. Flagged types…

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage, das:identity-collectors:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
- Returns 200: identitycollectortypesresponse

### GET /das/v1/identity-collectors/properties

`getIdentityCollectorBuiltinPropertiesV1` — List built-in identity collector properties

Returns the built-in source attribute names for users and groups collections. When no filter is provided, built-in properties for all public identity collector types are returned (the same base types listed by [List Identity Collector Types](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/get-identity-collector-types-v-1)). When filtered by `type`, only the matching type is returned; the filter accepts public type display names only (for example `AWS` or `Box`, not SaaS variants such as `AWS SaaS`).…

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage, das:identity-collectors:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: type: eq — e.g. `type eq "Azure Active Directory"`
- Returns 200: identitycollectorbuiltinpropertiesresponse

### PUT /das/v1/identity-collectors/{id}

`putIdentityCollectorV1` — Replace identity collector

Fully replaces an existing identity collector in Data Access Security. This is a PUT operation, not a partial update: the request body must contain the complete resource representation. Omitted or null top-level properties are rejected. After a successful request, a subsequent list request returns exactly the configuration that was sent. Retrieve the current configuration with [List Identity Collectors](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/list-identity-collectors-v-1) before replacing it.…

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the identity collector to replace.
- Body (application/json): updateidentitycollectorrequest
- Returns 204: no body

### DELETE /das/v1/identity-collectors/{id}

`deleteIdentityCollectorV1` — Delete identity collector by identifier

This endpoint deletes an identity collector from Data Access Security by its unique identifier.

- Scopes: das:identity-collectors:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the identity collector to delete.
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /das/v1/permissions/fields

`listDataDictionaryFieldsV1` — List data dictionary fields

Returns custom data dictionary fields that can be used when configuring identity collector field mappings and other permission-related settings. Built-in fields are not included in list responses; only custom fields created via [Create Data Dictionary Field](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/create-data-dictionary-field-v-1) are returned. All listed fields have `required: false`.

- Scopes: das:permissions:manage, das:permissions:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `filters` (query) — fields: dataDictionaryType: eq; name: eq — e.g. `dataDictionaryType eq "Users" and name eq "Department"`
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Returns 200: array of datadictionaryfieldlistitem

### POST /das/v1/permissions/fields

`createDataDictionaryFieldV1` — Create data dictionary field

Creates a custom data dictionary field. The server assigns fieldType String and required false; callers do not supply those values.

- Scopes: das:permissions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createdatadictionaryfieldrequest
- Returns 201: datadictionaryfieldlistitem

### PUT /das/v1/permissions/fields/{name}

`putDataDictionaryFieldV1` — Replace data dictionary field

Fully replaces a custom data dictionary field. This is a PUT operation, not a partial update: the request body must contain the complete resource representation. Omitted properties are rejected. For custom fields, `fieldType`, `dataDictionaryType`, and `required` must match the current values; only `name` may change. Built-in fields where `required` is true cannot be updated. List the field first with [List Data Dictionary…

- Scopes: das:permissions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The current field name.
- Body (application/json): updatedatadictionaryfieldrequest
- Returns 200: datadictionaryfieldlistitem

### DELETE /das/v1/permissions/fields/{name}

`deleteDataDictionaryFieldV1` — Delete data dictionary field

Deletes a custom data dictionary field. Built-in fields where required is true cannot be deleted.

- Scopes: das:permissions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `name` (path, required) — The field name to delete.
- Returns 204: no body
